question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

The origin or birth of a thing
solution:
The correct answer is **Genesis.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word **"Genesis" **(उद्भव) refers to the origin or birth of something.
 
• It is **commonly used to** describe the beginning or starting point of a process, event, or entity.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Genesis'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's take a look at the other options:
 
 
• **Culmination**: Culmination refers to the highest point or the climax of something (परिणति)
 
• **Coda**: Coda is a musical term referring to the concluding section of a piece (संगति)
 
• **Quietus**: Quietus means a state of rest or finality, typically in reference to death (निर्वाण)
